implementation_summary: Offline DocMDP and FieldMDP revision analysis is distinct from detached CMS integrity and explicit caller-anchor certificate-chain verification.

Allowed form filling creates a separate incremental file retaining exact original signed prefix, verifies modification policy before and after publication, and never claims the new values were signed by the old signer.
Field locks, no-changes certification, unrequested field changes, wrong/stale anchors, source fingerprint mismatch and existing output all fail closed.
Existing appearance streams cannot be overwritten by the stricter configured policy; only fresh selected-field appearance objects are published.

The first admitted form-writing scope is direct single-widget single-line text fields with printable ASCII; Unicode glyph coverage, hierarchical/repeated widgets, XFA and encrypted certified-form editing remain unqualified.

reproduced_failure_and_resolution.failure: The default in-place-appearance compatibility rule classified an untouched pre-signature appearance as a field modification, and ordinary pypdf form output reused appearance streams.
reproduced_failure_and_resolution.resolution: Use a stricter no-in-place-appearance policy and an explicit incremental writer publishing fresh appearance references only for requested fields. Locked-field assertions and unexpected-field checks remain intact.
